fields.name: crew_id
fields.description: Identifies a crew member. If possible, this should match other internal agency crew or employee IDs. The same crew_id may appear in multiple records over time as the crew member's role changes.

fields.name: crew_role
fields.description: Role of the crew member during the period this record covers.

fields.name: start_date
fields.description: Date this crew record becomes effective.

fields.name: end_date
fields.description: Date this crew record is no longer effective. Empty if currently effective.

name: crew.schema.json
description: Transit personnel who serve as vehicle or station crew, including operators, conductors, and fare inspectors.
